network: literal loopback only: backend 127.0.0.1:18765 and Ollama 127.0.0.1:11434; OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1
allowed: verify the bound candidate, all three harness blobs, offline evidence, fixed non-private sample, Ollama executable and model digest
preflight ports 18765 and 11434 in both Windows and WSL; stop without touching any pre-existing listener
start one run-owned local FastAPI process and one run-owned Windows-native Ollama process on the bound loopback ports
make at most one analysis submission through the real React -> FastAPI -> Ollama product path using the fixed sample
run one headless Chromium session for upload, analysis, explicit adoption, clipboard, TXT/JSON export and 360/1280/1920 screenshots
terminate only processes whose PID, creation identity and listener ownership match the run-owned records
after terminal live evidence, run one isolated read-only independent review session
persist minimized phase-specific results, hashes, screenshots, bounded sanitized diagnostics and dual-domain cleanup proof
required_checks: both Windows and WSL preflight snapshots show the bound ports free before startup
real same-origin UI/API production path reaches the bound local model and returns nonempty observations and English prompt
raw, suggestion and draft remain separate; adoption is explicit and raw output is collapsed by default
copy, TXT and JSON exports match the adopted draft without a second analysis submission
360/1280/1920 have no horizontal overflow and browser requests remain loopback-only
model unload, run-owned process termination, empty bound ports in both domains and run-temp removal are proven
independent review reports Fatal=0 and Major=0 before the human gate
mandatory_stops: candidate, evidence, harness, guard, sample, executable, model or authorization identity mismatch
any Windows or WSL listener already occupies 18765 or 11434, or process/listener ownership cannot be proven
any non-loopback connection, cloud attempt, extra analysis submission, download, cost or budget overrun
product-path, semantic, export, responsive, cleanup, privacy or evidence failure
any Fatal or Major independent finding
forbidden: visible browser, ComfyUI startup, paid service, cloud, download, upgrade, permanent configuration or remote Git push
media other than the hash-bound sample, retry under the same authorization or reuse/overwrite of r1a-live-01 evidence
termination of non-owned processes, use of occupied port 8765, lowering the fixed denominator or treating this run as V1 PASS
evidence_minimization: Do not persist source media bytes/base64, private absolute paths, secrets, unrelated PIDs/commands/process tables or full logs; retain aliases, hashes, bounded prompt fields, screenshots, sanitized log tails and owned terminal states.
cleanup: Require keep_alive=0 and empty /api/ps; terminate only identity-bound run-owned backend/Ollama processes; prove 18765/11434 empty in Windows and WSL; remove run temp; preserve minimized repository evidence.
expires_when: one terminal live receipt is generated, the single effective image/model attempt is consumed, any mandatory stop occurs, or the independent review is completed
